name: Grizzlepaw Ridge
summary: Grizzlepaw Ridge is a rugged, craggy hillside rising south of Thelsamar in Loch Modan. It is notorious among local mountaineers for its dense population of wild bears, led by the legendary beast Ol' Sooty.

sections.title: Home of the Bears
sections.body: Overlooking the road south of Thelsamar and bordering Stonesplinter Valley to the west, Grizzlepaw Ridge is rough country dominated by predatory wildlife. The slopes are claimed by territorial bears that pose a hazard to travelers skirting the mountains. Deep within the ridge dwells Ol' Sooty, a massive and unusually fierce bear feared by local hunters. Travelers moving between the dwarven settlements must keep a wary eye on the tree line and rocky terraces above.

aliases: how to get to grizzlepaw ridge
faq.answer: Grizzlepaw Ridge lies in the central hills of Loch Modan, directly south of the town of Thelsamar and east of the trogg-infested Stonesplinter Valley.

faq.q: What dangerous creatures live on Grizzlepaw Ridge?
faq.answer: The ridge is crawling with aggressive bears. Its most infamous resident is Ol' Sooty, an exceptionally large and ferocious beast that occasionally prowls down toward the mountain base.

angles.text: The ridge provides a classic proving ground for tracking wild beasts and confronting apex predators like Ol' Sooty.
Perched right beside Thelsamar, the ridge's bear population represents a constant nuisance to local mountaineers and supply routes.
